```{r}
library(mice)
library(lme4)
library(broom.mixed)
participants = read.csv(here::here("data","participants.csv"))

participants

vaccine_hist = read.csv(here::here("data", "participant_vaccineHistory.csv"))
vaccine_hist

flow_outcome = read.csv(here::here("data","publicData_ex_vivo_flow.csv"))

flow_outcome %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  summarise(
    n_by_name = n()
  )

flow_outcome %>%
  mutate(timepoint = ifelse(timepoint == "Pre-vacc", "0", as.character(timepoint))) %>%
  filter(timepoint == "0", participant_id %in% participants$participant_id) %>%
  distinct(participant_id, name) %>%
  count(name, sort = TRUE)

flow_wide <- flow_outcome %>%
  filter(name %in% c("Antibody-secreting_cells_(ASC)", "B_cells")) %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint = ifelse(timepoint == "Pre-vacc", "0", as.character(timepoint)),
    cell = recode(name,
                  "Antibody-secreting_cells_(ASC)" = "asc",
                  "B_cells" = "bcell")
    ) %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("0", "7")) %>%
  distinct(subject, cell, timepoint, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%       # drop the duplicate baselines
  select(participant_id, cell, timepoint, value, comments) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = participant_id,
    names_from  = c(cell, timepoint),
    values_from = c(value, comments),
    names_glue  = "{.value}_{cell}_d{timepoint}"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value_asc_d7)) %>%
  rename(round_d0 = comments_asc_d0, round_d7 = comments_asc_d7) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      starts_with("value_"), log, .names = "log_{.col}"
    )
  )

flow_wide

participants = participants %>%
  inner_join(flow_wide, by = "participant_id")

# aggregating the vaccine history data to get the number of prior vaccines for each participant
vaccine_hist_agg = vaccine_hist %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  summarise(
    n_prior_vax = sum(received %in% c("Yes_selfReported","Yes_Study"))
  )

# joining the vaccine history data to the participants data
participants_cleaned = left_join(participants, vaccine_hist_agg, by = "subject")

participants_vax = left_join(participants, vaccine_hist, by = "subject")
participants_vax

nrow(participants_cleaned)                       # expect 29
anyDuplicated(participants_cleaned$participant_id)   # expect 0


pb_d0_log <- participants$log_value_asc_d0
dat_lobo <- participants %>%
  select(participant_id, log_value_asc_d7, log_value_asc_d0, round_d7)

y_log     <- dat_lobo$log_value_asc_d7
pb_d0_log <- dat_lobo$log_value_asc_d0
rounds    <- unique(dat_lobo$round_d7)
test_idx <- which(dat_lobo$round_d7 == r)

lobo_pred <- rep(NA_real_, length(y_log))
lobo_base <- rep(NA_real_, length(y_log))

for (r in rounds) {
  test_idx <- which(participants$round_d7 == r)
  train <- data.frame(y = y_log[-test_idx], pb0 = pb_d0_log[-test_idx])
  test  <- data.frame(pb0 = pb_d0_log[test_idx])

  med <- median(train$pb0, na.rm = TRUE)          # impute within fold
  train$pb0[is.na(train$pb0)] <- med
  test$pb0[is.na(test$pb0)]   <- med

  lobo_pred[test_idx] <- predict(lm(y ~ pb0, data = train), newdata = test)
  lobo_base[test_idx] <- mean(train$y)
}

sqrt(mean((y_log - lobo_base)^2))   # baseline RMSE
sqrt(mean((y_log - lobo_pred)^2))   # day-0 ASC RMSE




day0 <- flow_outcome %>%
  mutate(timepoint = ifelse(timepoint == "Pre-vacc", "0", as.character(timepoint))) %>%
  filter(timepoint == "0",
         participant_id %in% participants$participant_id,
         value > 0) %>%
  distinct(participant_id, name, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Round effect per population (Kruskal-Wallis on log values)
round_tests <- day0 %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(comments) > 1, n() >= 15) %>%
  summarise(p = kruskal.test(log(value) ~ factor(comments))$p.value,
            n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(p)
round_tests

# Heatmap of median log-frequency by round, scaled within each population
day0 %>%
  group_by(name, comments) %>%
  summarise(med = median(log(value)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  mutate(z = (med - mean(med)) / sd(med)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(comments, name, fill = z)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2() +
  labs(x = "Experimental round", y = NULL, fill = "Scaled median")
```

```{r}
dat <- data.frame(
  log_value_d7 = participants_cleaned$log_value_d7,
  log_value_d0 = participants_cleaned$log_value_d0,   # contains the NAs
  n_prior_vax  = participants_cleaned$n_prior_vax,
  age          = participants_cleaned$age,
  sex          = factor(participants_cleaned$biological_sex),
  round_d7        = factor(participants_cleaned$round_d7)   # include if you'll adjust for batch
)

md.pattern(dat)   # shows which variables are missing, and for whom

ini  <- mice(dat, maxit = 0)       # dry run to get default settings
meth <- ini$method
meth                               # should be "pmm" for log_value_d0, "" for complete vars

imp <- mice(dat, m = 40, maxit = 20, method = meth, seed = 2026, printFlag = FALSE)

plot(imp)                              # convergence: lines should mix with no trend
densityplot(imp, ~ log_value_d0)       # imputed (red) vs observed (blue)
stripplot(imp, log_value_d0 ~ .imp)    # imputed values per dataset
imp$loggedEvents                       # should be NULL; otherwise see what was dropped

fits_mm <- with(imp, lmer(log_value_d7 ~ log_value_d0 + n_prior_vax + age + sex + (1 | round_d7)))

fits_fixed <- with(imp, lm(log_value_d7 ~ log_value_d0 + n_prior_vax + age + sex))
summary(pool(fits_mm), conf.int = TRUE)
summary(pool(fits_fixed), conf.int = TRUE)

# Is the round random effect doing anything?
summary(fits_mm$analyses[[1]])            # look at the round_d7 variance
sapply(fits_mm$analyses, isSingular)      # TRUE = variance estimated at ~0

# Sensitivity analyses
cc   <- lm(log_value_d7 ~ log_value_d0 + n_prior_vax + age + sex, data = dat)  # n = 23
nobl <- lm(log_value_d7 ~ n_prior_vax + age + sex, data = dat)                 # n = 29

# Floor value sensitivity (ID_275, day 7 at 1e-04)
dat_nofloor <- dat[participants_cleaned$value_d7 > 1e-04, ]

get_vax <- function(x, label) {
  s <- if (inherits(x, "mipo")) summary(x, conf.int = TRUE) else broom::tidy(x, conf.int = TRUE)
  s <- s[s$term == "n_prior_vax", c("estimate", "conf.low", "conf.high", "p.value")]
  cbind(model = label, s)
}

rbind(
  get_vax(pool(fits_mm),    "MI + round (lmer)"),
  get_vax(pool(fits_fixed), "MI (lm)"),
  get_vax(cc,               "Complete case"),
  get_vax(nobl,             "No baseline adj.")
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidydr)
library(gtsummary)
library(here)

cohort = readRDS(here::here("data", "participants_cleaned.rds"))
rnaseq = readRDS(here::here("data", "rnaseq.rds"))
vaccine_hist = readRDS(here::here("data", "vaccine_hist.rds"))

result = left_join(cohort, rnaseq, by = "participant_id") %>%
  group_by(participant_id, biological_sex, n_prior_vax) %>%
  summarise(
    n_unique_genes = n_distinct(ensembl_gene_id),
    counts = sum(counts)
  )

vaccine_hist[vaccine_hist$participant_id %in% cohort_missing_vax$participant_id,]

cohort_missing_vax = cohort %>%
  filter(n_prior_vax == 0)

cohort_missing_vax$

rnaseq %>%
  group_by(material) %>%
  summarise(
    counts = n()
  )
result




ct <- cor.test(result$n_prior_vax, result$counts, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)

p_lib_vax <- ggplot(result, aes(x = factor(n_prior_vax), y = counts / 1e6)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "col", fill = "#4C72B0", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.25, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 2, alpha = 0.7, colour = "grey20") +
  labs(
    title    = "Total RNA-seq transcript counts by vaccination history",
    subtitle = sprintf("Mean ± SE, points show participants (n = %d); Spearman's rho = %.2f, p = %.2f",
                       nrow(result), ct$estimate, ct$p.value),
    x        = "Number of prior seasonal influenza vaccinations",
    y        = "Total transcript counts (millions)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = "grey40"),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )
```
